query:
SELECT f.target_account_id FROM follows f
        WHERE f.account_id = $1 AND NOT f.pending
          AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM follows g
              WHERE g.account_id = f.target_account_id
                AND g.target_account_id = $1 AND NOT g.pending
          )
        ORDER BY f.id DESC
        OFFSET $2 LIMIT $3
